target.section: Acceptance Criteria > US-001 > AC-9; Stories > Seams

action.newText:
Acceptance Criteria > US-001 > AC-9: Mounting pages/threads/[id].vue (workspace thread) with the real composer and a useWorkspaceThread double whose send resolves { ok: true }, Enter on hello calls the double's send once with hello, and the textarea is empty afterwards.

Stories > Seams, US-001: Drive the real ThreadComposer from each real thread detail page: Enter reaches useThread().send on the project page and useWorkspaceThread().send on the workspace page through each page's onSend, and the composer reacts to the returned result.

rationale: This corrects an incompatible test-seam reference without changing workspace routing, send behavior, or acceptance coverage. No other AC conflicts were found; the additional failure-handling ACs restate existing spec requirements.

The complete branch review reports no open findings and all local gates passed. Spot-checks found no concrete defect: workspace authorization remains intact, composer sends are guarded, and unavailable-agent messaging waits for discovery.
